register.name: Name
register.roleQuestion: How will you use the app?
register.patientHelp: I take my own medicines and use my watch.
register.caregiverHelp: I add the medicines and pair the watch of each person in my care.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.sent: If the email exists, we've sent instructions to choose a new password. The link expires in one hour.
forgot.sentHelp: It only arrives if the account's email is verified. If it doesn't arrive, check your spam folder or verify your email from the panel.
forgot.intro: We'll send you a link to choose a new password. The account's email must be verified.

verify.done: Email verified. You can keep using the app.
verify.askNew: Request a new link from the panel.

account.title: Your account
account.unverifiedHelp: Until it is verified you won't get email alerts or be able to reset your password.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.intro: If you delete your account, your data is erased permanently. Before you continue, we'll show you what will be deleted.
delete.patient: Your account and all your health data will be deleted: medicines, schedules, doses, reports and consents. Your watch will be unpaired.
delete.caregiver: Your account will be deleted. Patients you manage who have no other active caregiver will be deleted with all their data; those with other caregivers are kept for them.
delete.understand: I understand this cannot be undone

landing.heroBody: A Wear OS watch that alerts at every dose, with no phone and no internet, and a panel where the caregiver sees whether it was taken.
landing.heroWatchAlt: Watch illustration: 5 of 8 doses taken, next one at 14:00.
landing.fact1Small: without internet: the plan lives on the watch
landing.fact3Small: a short one on the watch to pair it
landing.stepsTitle: Ready in three steps, from your phone.
landing.step1Body: In the panel, with their dose, colour and times. Your phone works too.
landing.step2Body: The watch shows a short code; you enter it in Settings and it downloads the plan.
landing.step3Body: The watch rings on time. Here you see every dose and, if one is missed, we let you know.
landing.watchTitle: The watch does the work; the patient just taps “Taken”.
landing.watch1: It rings and vibrates on time: Taken, Snooze or Skip, with one tap.
landing.watch2: Snooze gives 10 minutes, up to 3 times; Skip asks for confirmation.
landing.watch3: It works on its own, with no phone; without internet it still alerts for 7 days.
landing.watch4: Large text and buttons; the medicine's colour always comes with its name.
landing.watchAlarmAlt: Illustration of the alert on the watch: Losartan, 50 mg, 14:00, with the Taken button.
landing.panelTitle: In the panel, at a glance: was it taken?
landing.panelBody: How many doses so far, which one is next, and each one in its time of day with its status. If needed, you can mark it from here.
landing.panelAlt: Panel example: 5 of 8 doses taken today, the next one at 14:00, and the morning with Losartan and Metformin taken.
landing.privacyBody: We follow Colombia's Law 1581 of 2012 on personal data protection. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
landing.privacy1Body: Health data, the assistant and alerts are accepted separately, and consent can be withdrawn.
landing.privacy2Body: The treatment is seen by the patient and the caregivers they invite.
landing.privacy3Body: From Settings, with your password. Your data is erased.
landing.faq1A: No. The Wear OS watch works on its own. The panel opens in any browser, on your phone too.
landing.faq2Q: What if the watch has no internet?
landing.faq2A: It keeps alerting: it stores the plan for the next 7 days and the alarms live on the watch itself. Doses are uploaded when the connection comes back.
landing.faq3A: A watch with Wear OS 4 or later, round or square.
landing.faq4Q: How do I find out if a dose was not taken?
landing.faq4A: In the panel you'll see it as “Not taken”. You can also get an alert by Telegram or email.
landing.faq5Q: Can I care for more than one person?
landing.faq5A: Yes. In the panel you choose who you manage, and each person has their own plan.
landing.ctaTitle: Start today: the first alert rings on time.
landing.footer: Recuerda · medication reminders on your watch.
